items.title: CVE-2026-111357: Ivanti Connect Secure local privilege escalation to root in dsinvoked broker (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Ivanti Connect Secure has a flaw in how its dsinvoked broker trusts DSCache configuration data, which lets an attacker who already has code execution as the cgi-server user escalate to root and run commands as root on the appliance. The attacker must have local access and a low-privilege login, public exploit code exists, and CISA lists the flaw as actively exploited in attacks.

A suspected China-nexus espionage group, ARMORY CASTLE, exploited it as a zero-day from early September 2026. items.title: CVE-2026-131914: Idunno AntiCsrf remote code execution in ASP.NET CSRF token validation (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. The Idunno AntiCsrf software for ASP.NET unsafely deserializes untrusted data during its double-submit cookie and form field validation. A remote attacker can exploit this through object injection to execute code, without logging in over the network.

items.title: CVE-2026-133968: Project-MONIA MONAI Label remote code execution via path traversal in datastore API (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. MONAI Label contains a directory traversal flaw in the image parameter of its PUT /datastore/image endpoint, which can lead to remote code execution. An attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in and without any user action.

items.title: CVE-2026-20131: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center remote code execution in web management interface (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center software has a flaw in its web-based management interface that lets an attacker run arbitrary Java code on the device and gain root privileges. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, so attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-133968 — Project MONAI
items.summary: Project MONAI — monailabel (aka MONAI Label) before 0.8.6 allows directory traversal, with resultant remote code execution, via the image parameter to the PUT /datastore/image endpoint, as exploited in the wild starting in September 2026.

items.title: CVE-2026-59309: VMware authentication bypass in VMware Directory Service (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. VMware vCenter, which is also part of products such as Cloud Foundation, vSphere Foundation, Telco Cloud Infrastructure and Telco Cloud Platform, has a flaw in its VMware Directory Service that lets an attacker bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, and public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-0769: Langflow remote code execution in custom component evaluation (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Langflow contains a flaw in its eval_custom_component_code function, which fails to properly validate a user-supplied string before running it as Python code. Remotely, without logging in, an attacker can exploit this to execute arbitrary code in the context of the running Langflow process, and public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-87902: WordPress remote code execution in page template resolution (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. WordPress has a flaw in how it picks a page template, which lets an attacker make the site load a chosen readable PHP file from outside the theme folders. It can be reached remotely without logging in and can lead to remote code execution when certain server and theme conditions are met, and it is listed as being exploited in attacks, with public exploit code available.

items.title: CVE-2026-124284
items.summary: A critical security vulnerability affects certain authentication methods in Genetec Security Center, including external identity providers using OpenID Connect (OIDC) or SAML 2.0, and Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) using WS-Trust or WS-Federation. Under specific conditions, successful exploitation may allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to the system with the privileges of an affected user. items.title: CVE-2026-136455
items.summary: borg-ui before 2.4.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows a repository-scoped operator to escalate to full administrator by exploiting an unrestricted source_directories field in the backup-plan API that lacks path allow-listing. Attackers can configure a backup plan to archive the application's data directory, download the resulting archive to extract the static HS256 .secret_key, and use it to forge a JWT with sub":"admin" to access admin-only endpoints like GET /api/auth/users, achieving full application takeover without admin credentials, XSS, or CSRF.

items.title: CVE-2026-136241
items.summary: UWAS before 0.11.16 contains a WAF bypass vulnerability in the isAPContentType() function within internal/middleware/security.go that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade SQL injection, XSS, and shell/RCE body pattern detection by setting the Content-Type header to application/json, multipart/form-data, or other exempted types. Attackers can relabel the Content-Type of malicious requests to skip WAF body scanning entirely, causing the unfiltered payload to pass through byte-for-byte to the backend application without being logged as a WAF event.

items.title: CVE-2026-136178
items.summary: Endurain before 0.20.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the PUT /api/v1/strava/link endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify Strava integrations using only a victim's strava_state value. Attackers can submit a leaked state with their own OAuth code to link an attacker-controlled Strava account, or an invalid code to remove the victim's integration.

items.title: CVE-2026-136165
items.summary: Fider before 0.40.0 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to sign in as existing users by linking OAuth identities through unverified email matches. Attackers can use a Google account carrying an unverified copy of a victim's email, including a tenant administrator's, to bind their identity via the OAuthToken handler and obtain persistent session access.

items.title: CVE-2026-136133
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in passwordForgot() that allows unauthenticated attackers to revoke a user's sessions by requesting a password reset. Attackers who know a user's email can repeatedly request resets to sign out users, including super-admins, and permanently destroy their OAuth and MCP application authorizations.

items.title: CVE-2026-121456
items.summary: A privilege escalation vulnerability in the Axivion Suite ApiToken permission restriction for OIDC and SAML users of the Axivion Dashboard. For users who sign in to the Dashboard through OIDC, or through the SAML preview feature, this restriction has no effect. Exploitability is low: an attacker needs an ApiToken that has been leaked, or one that was shared on the assumption that its permissions were restricted.

items.title: CVE-2011-10019: Spreecommerce remote code execution in search parameter (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Spreecommerce versions prior to 0.60.2 contains a remote command execution vulnerability in its search functionality. The application fails to properly sanitize input passed via the search[send][] parameter, which is dynamically invoked using Ruby’s send method. This allows attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands on the server without authentication.

items.title: CVE-2011-10026: Spreecommerce remote code execution in API search parameter (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Spreecommerce versions prior to 0.50.x contain a remote command execution vulnerability in the API's search functionality. Improper input sanitation allows attackers to inject arbitrary shell commands via the search[instance_eval] parameter, which is dynamically invoked using Ruby’s send method. This flaw enables unauthenticated attackers to execute commands on the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-118527: Ivanti Connect Secure authenticated remote file upload via predictable filenames (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Ivanti Connect Secure has a flaw that lets an attacker who is logged in with a low-privilege account upload files with content they control to a known location on the device's disk, reaching it remotely over the network with no user interaction needed. It can be chained with other vulnerabilities, public exploit code is available, and attacks using it are happening.

items.title: CVE-2025-22457: Ivanti Connect Secure remote code execution via stack buffer overflow (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Ivanti Connect Secure, Ivanti Policy Secure, and Ivanti ZTA Gateways are affected by a stack-based buffer overflow flaw. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit it to run arbitrary code on the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-20045: Cisco Unified Communications Manager remote code execution in web management interface (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Cisco Unified Communications Manager, its IM and Presence Service, and Cisco Unity Connection have a flaw in how they check input in web requests, which lets an attacker run commands on the underlying operating system and gain full root control. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, through the web-based management interface, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-50522: Microsoft SharePoint Enterprise Server 2016 remote code execution via unsafe deserialization (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Microsoft SharePoint Server (including the Enterprise Server 2016, Server 2019 and Subscription Edition releases) has a flaw in how it handles untrusted data, which lets an attacker run code on the SharePoint server. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in or any user action, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2021-22893: Pulse Connect Secure authentication bypass in Windows File Share Browser (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Pulse Connect Secure, a VPN gateway product, is affected through its Windows File Share Browser and Pulse Secure Collaboration features. An unauthenticated attacker could bypass login and run arbitrary code on the gateway.

items.title: CVE-2015-3306: ProFTPD access control bypass in mod_copy (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The mod_copy module in ProFTPD, an FTP server (including the Debian proftpd-dfsg package), lets an attacker copy files around on the server and possibly run arbitrary code. The attacker can do this remotely without logging in by using the "site cpfr" and "site cpto" commands. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-20320: Cisco BroadWorks remote file read via XXE in OCI XML parser (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Cisco BroadWorks has a flaw in how its OCI-P service handles XML, letting an attacker read sensitive files, including configuration information, from the system with the privileges of the BroadWorks user. It can be exploited remotely without logging in by sending a crafted XML message, public exploit code is available, and attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-129448: Apache Roller unauthenticated code execution in XML-RPC endpoint (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Apache Roller has a deserialization flaw in its XML-RPC endpoint that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code on the server without logging in. The endpoint deserializes vendor extension types before it checks the requester's identity.

items.title: CVE-2018-8581: Microsoft Exchange privilege escalation in email server software (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. This vulnerability affects Microsoft Exchange Server, Microsoft's email and collaboration server software. An attacker who can already run code or access the system could exploit it to gain higher privileges than they are authorized to have.

items.title: CVE-2026-20963: Microsoft SharePoint Enterprise Server 2016 remote code execution via unsafe deserialization (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Microsoft SharePoint Server (including the 2016 Enterprise, 2019, and Subscription Edition releases) has a flaw in how it handles untrusted data, which lets an attacker run code on the server. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in or any user interaction, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2010-1871: JBoss Enterprise Application Platform remote code execution in expression language (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. JBoss Seam 2 as used in JBoss Enterprise Application Platform for Red Hat Linux is affected. A remote attacker could exploit improper input sanitization in Expression Language handling through a crafted URL to execute arbitrary code, though this only applies when the Java Security Manager is not properly configured.

items.title: CVE-2026-135388

items.title: CVE-2026-133646
items.summary: Synchronet BBS, in versions 3.20b to 3.21e, contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the answer() function when processing the terminal attribute of the SSH service. The call to cryptGetAttributeString() does not limit the copy to the size of the destination buffer, of which 41 bytes are used. An unauthenticated remote client can send a TERM value of up to 64 bytes and overwrite adjacent fields of the session object. If the SSH service is enabled, this tampering can cause connection threads to be blocked for an extended period, even after the client has disconnected. By exhausting the…

items.title: CVE-2026-121613
items.summary: Missing authentication and authorization on an exposed interface allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to send arbitrary commands to the affected component, which can force a device reboot or let the attacker upload malicious firmware.

items.title: CVE-2026-86312
items.summary: Under some configurations a request to the ping endpoint could carry out more than a simple health check. In deployments that rely on Solr's rule-based authorization, a client granted only the low-privilege health permission could thereby trigger behavior that should require higher privileges; where the shipped security.json template leaves the health permission unauthenticated, no credentials are required at all. This issue affects Apache Solr from 9.0.0 through the releases preceding the fixed versions. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.11.0 or 10.1.0, which resolve the issue. Yo…

items.title: CVE-2026-93584
items.summary: An SQL injection vulnerability in OTRS versions 2024.3.1 through 2026.8.1 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to inject arbitrary SQL expressions through the Survey endpoint. The vulnerability exists in the Kernel::System::Survey::Request::RequestGet() method, which directly incorporates an attacker-controlled survey key into a SQL query without using parameterized statements. Successful exploitation allows attackers to retrieve ticket information and perform boolean-based or time-based blind SQL injection to extract potentially sensitive data accessible to the OTRS database account. Explo…

items.title: CVE-2026-134825
items.summary: Gradio 6.27.0 before 6.32.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in gradio/history.py that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to use the operator's locally saved Hugging Face token by sending a forged Host: localhost header. When ssr_mode is enabled, requests proxied through the local Node SSR server pass the loopback check, letting attackers call run history endpoints to list buckets, read records and assets, and write buckets under the operator's account.

items.title: CVE-2026-134813
items.summary: Faye websocket-driver 0.5.0 before 0.8.0, permessage-deflate before 0.2.0, and websocket-extensions before 0.2.0 contain a decompression bomb vulnerability because messages are fully inflated before maxLength is enforced. Unauthenticated remote clients negotiating permessage-deflate can send highly compressible messages, forcing processIncomingMessage() to allocate excessive memory and crash the server process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134809
items.summary: OpenOLAT 20.2.2 before 20.3.12, 21.0.0 before 21.0.7, and 21.1.0 before 21.1.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the TranscodingDeliveryDispatcher notifyResult callback endpoint. Unauthenticated attackers can POST crafted TranscoderJobResult JSON with attacker-supplied URLs to overwrite transcoded video and audio files and force server-side requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-134807
items.summary: Reposilite 3.5.27 before 3.6.7 contains a brute-force protection bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to evade login bans by spoofing the X-Forwarded-For header. Attackers can rotate the header value to make unlimited password or token guesses, or forge failed attempts to lock out legitimate clients.

items.title: CVE-2026-134838
items.summary: Weblate before 2026.11 contains an account takeover vulnerability in the reset_password view that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset victim passwords by abusing case-insensitive Unicode e-mail matching. Attackers controlling a lookalike mailbox using a dotless i or other case-folding variant receive the victim's reset link, since it is sent to the typed address, and set a new password.

items.title: CVE-2026-134831
items.summary: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read unpublished help center articles through the public portal API. Attackers can request archived articles by slug via the ArticlesController show actions or read draft translations exposed through associated_articles in article JSON responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-134826
items.summary: erxes before 3.4.14 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the insurance_api plugin that allows unauthenticated attackers to create, overwrite or delete contract templates via GraphQL mutations. Attackers can inject HTML into templates rendered by headless Chromium during generateContractPDF to pull internal network content into PDFs and exfiltrate customer fields.

items.title: CVE-2026-134821
items.summary: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI HTTP/1 parser that buffers protocol lines without size limits. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send request lines, headers, chunk-size lines or trailers lacking CRLF to grow worker memory and consume CPU, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134820
items.summary: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains an HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI parser that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to desynchronize request framing by sending malformed framing headers. Attackers can send whitespace-padded Transfer-Encoding or Content-Length headers, signed Content-Length values, or invalid chunk terminators to smuggle requests past front-end proxies to the ASGI application.

items.title: CVE-2026-134796
items.summary: Donetick before 0.1.86 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the GET /api/v1/assets/*filepath route that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass URL signature checks by prefixing paths with profiles/. Attackers who know a private upload's storage key can request profiles/../users//. to retrieve private attachments without a signature or login.

items.title: CVE-2026-134795
items.summary: graphql-core 3.2.12 before 3.2.14 and 3.3.0rc1 before 3.3.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the parser max_tokens limit using long runs of comments. Attackers can submit GraphQL documents of consecutive comments that Lexer.lookahead fully tokenizes before limit checks, consuming CPU and memory proportional to document size.

items.title: CVE-2026-134833
items.summary: RSSHub before 2026.11.01-8521.e529e9b contains a domain validation bypass in the javdb routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to capture the operator's JAVDB_SESSION cookie. Attackers can pass an absolute javdb.com URL in the category parameter and set the domain query to a host they control, causing processItems to send the _jdb_session cookie there.

items.title: CVE-2026-134748
items.summary: Members WordPress plugin by MemberPress 3.2.28 before 3.3.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to evade Private Site mode via login page exemption. Attackers can request the front-end login path with a pagename query variable to make WordPress render hidden published pages or the full blog index.

items.title: CVE-2026-134752
items.summary: WPGSI: Spreadsheet Integration before 3.8.5 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to delete posts by abusing the delete action in wpgsi_show_view() without nonce verification. Attackers can trick a logged-in administrator into following a crafted wpgsi-show link with action=delete and an id parameter to delete arbitrary posts or pages.

items.title: CVE-2026-134751
items.summary: Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read role-restricted posts by viewing Latest Posts blocks in full-content mode. The block renders raw post_content without firing the_content filter, bypassing members_content_permissions_protect() and exposing complete bodies of restricted posts.

items.title: CVE-2026-134750
items.summary: Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read comments on role-restricted posts via the Latest Comments block. Attackers can view pages hosting the block, where get_the_ID() checks the host page and get_comment_excerpt() bypasses filtering, exposing restricted comments, post titles, and links.

items.title: CVE-2026-134753
items.summary: dsniff through 2.5a2 contains an integer underflow in decode_sniffer() in decode_sniffer.c that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write past the global obuf buffer. Attackers can send a UDP datagram to port 2001 on a monitored segment with a 4096-byte string, disabling base64_pton bounds checks to corrupt memory and crash dsniff.

items.title: CVE-2026-134651
items.summary: A flaw was found in Quay. This vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker holding a restricted, short-lived JSON Web Token (JWT) to achieve privilege escalation. Because Quay improperly accepts scoped registry bearer tokens as valid robot account passwords, an attacker can authenticate directly as the robot account and obtain broader permissions. Consequently, unauthorized access persists and enables the attacker to generate fresh tokens even after the robot account's password has been reset.

items.title: CVE-2026-127024
items.summary: The WordForm WordPress plugin before 4.1.6 does not properly validate uploaded files, allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files, including PHP, which leads to remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-123136
items.summary: The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.2 does not check that the ticket type and price chosen through one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions belong to the event ticket later added to the cart, and stores them site-wide, allowing unauthenticated visitors to buy an event ticket at the lower ticket-type price configured on a different event.

items.title: CVE-2026-132814
items.summary: The WPO365 | SEAMLESS WORDPRESS + MICROSOFT INTEGRATION (WPO365 | LOGIN) WordPress plugin before 45.0 does not verify that a Microsoft ID token was issued for the site's own application and tenant when multi-tenant sign-in is enabled with an empty list of allowed tenants, allowing unauthenticated attackers to log in as an existing user, including an administrator, with a token Microsoft issued to an application they control.

items.title: CVE-2026-123068
items.summary: The Front User Submit WordPress plugin before 5.1.0 does not validate the content of files uploaded through one of its unauthenticated endpoints and later serves them back with a Content-Type derived from the file's bytes and an inline disposition, allowing unauthenticated attackers to store an HTML or SVG payload and obtain a same-origin URL that executes arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of any user who opens it, including an administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-120413
items.summary: The Yoast SEO WordPress plugin before 28.9 does not check that content is publicly viewable before returning its SEO metadata through a public REST endpoint, allowing unauthenticated users who know or can guess the URL of a private post, page or custom post type item to read its title, author, publication date and an excerpt of its content.

items.title: CVE-2026-134679
items.summary: WeddingShare through 1.8.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the anonymous MediaViewerController.GalleryItem action that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve item upload paths without the gallery secret key. Attackers can enumerate sequential integer item ids to learn paths and uploader names, then download photos and videos from key-protected galleries served as static files.

items.title: CVE-2026-134654
items.summary: Mailflare before 48957fb contains a host header injection vulnerability in the password-reset request handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to poison reset links when APP_URL is unset. Attackers can submit a reset request for a victim's email with a malicious Host header, capturing the single-use token when the victim clicks the link to take over the account.

items.title: CVE-2026-134451
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows non-admin users with settings:edit permission to modify OIDC provider configuration due to an improper permission check. Attackers can send a PUT request to /api/auth/oidc/ setting adminClaim to their own OIDC group, gaining full admin access on their next OIDC login.

items.title: CVE-2026-125294
items.summary: The Nexter Blocks Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.10 via the `tpgb_ajax_register_user()` function. This is due to a byte-level denylist on the `tpgb_acf_key[]` and `tpgb_acf[]` parameters that fails to block Unicode look-alike characters — such as U+1E87 and U+00E7 in a key like `ẇp_çapabilities` — whose UTF-8 byte sequences do not match any ASCII-based pattern check, while the database's default accent-insensitive collation (`utf8mb4_unicode_ci` / `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci`) treats the decorated key as equivalent to the canoni…

items.title: CVE-2026-134461
items.summary: Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.10, 4.0.0 before 4.0.7, and 4.1.0 before 4.1.7 contain an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in PBES2AESKW::unwrapKey(), which passes the attacker-controlled p2c JWE header value to hash_pbkdf2() without an upper bound. Unauthenticated attackers can send a JWE using a PBES2-HS*+A*KW algorithm with a huge p2c iteration count to force lengthy PBKDF2 computations and exhaust server CPU.

items.title: CVE-2026-134352
items.summary: Rclone from 1.51.0 before 1.76.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in serve sftp --auth-proxy because the generateCacheKey cache key omits the authentication method. Attackers knowing a victim's base64 public key can submit it as a password from the same client IP to reuse the cached entry and gain read-write VFS access.

items.title: CVE-2026-134318
items.summary: better-auth 1.5.5 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the organization plugin, where the creator role check compares the raw invitation role string while later checks trim it. Admins or other non-creator roles that can invite can submit a padded role such as " owner" that becomes owner on acceptance, allowing deletion of the organization and removal of original owners.

items.title: CVE-2026-134253
items.summary: Grav API plugin from 1.0.0 before 1.1.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows publishers with media and page write rights to write theme template files through the blueprint-upload endpoint. Attackers can upload a file into a theme's Twig templates folder and include it from sandboxed page Twig to execute commands as the web-server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-134287
items.summary: OpenRemote core before 1.34.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in UserAssetProvisioningMQTTHandler that allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate provisioned devices without proof of private key possession. Attackers can publish a known device's public certificate to the provisioning request topic, authenticating their anonymous MQTT connection as the device's service account to read and modify assets.

items.title: CVE-2026-134249
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain Administrator role by spoofing X-Forwarded-For through a loopback-trusted reverse proxy. Attackers can send requests with Host set to localhost and X-Forwarded-For set to 127.0.0.1 to read private note-history contents via the /history/*path route when no lock-screen password is set.

items.title: CVE-2026-134349
items.summary: Rclone from 1.46.0 before 1.76.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the remote control server that allows unauthenticated clients to crash rclone by sending oversized JSON bodies. Attackers can POST large JSON payloads to protected RC methods, which handlePost decodes before authorization checks, triggering out-of-memory termination and interrupting transfers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134348
items.summary: Rclone from 1.56.0 before 1.76.0 contains a timing side-channel vulnerability in its htpasswd authentication middleware that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate valid usernames. Attackers can send HTTP Basic Auth requests with wrong passwords and measure response times, because bcrypt verification runs only for existing users, enabling targeted password guessing.

items.title: CVE-2026-134347
items.summary: actix-files before 0.7.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read hidden files by requesting Windows 8.3 short-name aliases. Attackers can request short names like ENV~1 or GIT~1/config to bypass the leading-dot check in actix_files::Files and retrieve .env secrets and .git contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-134341
items.summary: actix-http 3.0.0 before 3.20.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to exhaust memory by sending large-window brotli request bodies. Attackers can send an 850-byte body with Content-Encoding: br declaring a 2^30 window, forcing about 1 GiB of decoder allocation per request and OOM-killing servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134325
items.summary: ArcadeDB before 26.11.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the Redis protocol handler, which neither replies to nor closes a pre-authentication connection when it receives an array whose first element is not a string. Unauthenticated attackers can resend such an array just within the 30-second socket idle timeout to hold connections open indefinitely and exhaust RedisNetworkExecutor threads.

items.title: CVE-2026-134314
items.summary: better-auth 1.3.7 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains a race condition in the emailOTP plugin attempt counter, collision-prone email change code keys, and accent-insensitive email lookups. Unauthenticated attackers can send concurrent guesses exceeding allowedAttempts to brute-force OTPs and sign in or reset passwords, signed-in users can verify addresses they do not own, and attackers receiving mail at accent-variant addresses can reset victims' passwords.

items.title: CVE-2026-133250
items.summary: @fastify/middie is the middleware engine for the Fastify web framework. In versions up to and including 9.3.7, middie matches path-scoped middleware against its own reading of the request path, which can differ from the path Fastify's router uses to dispatch the request. When the two disagree, the router can route a request to a handler covered by a middleware mount while middie skips that middleware, so an unauthenticated client reaches a handler that an authentication, authorization, or rate-limiting middleware was meant to protect, with no special configuration required. The mismatch is tri…

items.title: CVE-2026-134259
items.summary: Admidio from 5.0.16 before 5.0.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with folder upload rights to store JavaScript by uploading SVG files served inline. Attackers can upload a script-bearing SVG that downloadFile() serves as image/svg+xml inline without nosniff or CSP, executing on the Admidio origin for viewers including unauthenticated visitors.

items.title: CVE-2026-134245
items.summary: SiYuan 3.8.0 before 3.8.10 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the serveAssets route that allows unauthenticated attackers to read password-protected document assets via name collisions. Attackers can request GET /assets/ when a visible document references the same relative asset name, retrieving the protected file's contents on public-publish instances with Basic Auth disabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-134244
items.summary: SiYuan 3.8.0 before 3.8.10 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in LAN sync that allows adjacent unauthenticated attackers to obtain device metadata by advertising a counterfeit peer with a replayed discovery tag. The client sends the sync scope ID, device name, OS, app version, and TLS client certificate to /peer-sync/v1/session/open before validating the server proof.

items.title: CVE-2026-124626
items.summary: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions 4.0.5 through 4.0.9, the plugin matches path-scoped Express middleware with a matcher that requires a non-empty value for a dynamic segment, while Fastify's router accepts an empty parameter or wildcard value. items.title: CVE-2026-134378
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 12.7.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 stores imported Italian supplier e-invoices as public files in the Regional module, which the server returns without authentication. Unauthenticated attackers can request predictable file URLs built from the supplier's VAT number and invoice sequence to read supplier names, VAT numbers, bank account details and line items.

In versions 2.1.0 through 6.1.4, the authentication hooks that applications register to protect the documentation are applied to every route the plugin adds except the bundled static asset instance. When the option that serves bundled UI files from a local directory is enabled, that instance exposes every file in the directory without credentials, so a specification file an operator meant to keep behind the documentation login becomes reachable by an unauthenticated client who knows or guesses its…

items.title: CVE-2026-134299
items.summary: SurrealDB 3.0.4 before 4.0.0 does not apply operator-configured WebSocket frame, message, and buffer size limits to the GraphQL WebSocket upgrade handler at GET /graphql, falling back to permissive library defaults. Unauthenticated remote attackers who supply the target namespace and database in request headers can hold up to 64 MiB of in-flight data per concurrent connection, exhausting server memory and degrading availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-119177

The issue is fixed in Metasploit Framework 6.5.10

items.title: Bromcom - 355,051 breached accounts
items.summary: In September 2026, UK education software provider Bromcom suffered a data breach involving a legacy single sign-on (SSO) registration system . The incident exposed 355k unique email addresses belonging to staff and pupils at UK schools, alongside SSO registration reference numbers. Bromcom confirmed that no passwords or authentication tokens were exposed, and that the incident did not enable access to Microsoft or Google accounts or its school management system.

items.title: CVE-2026-134624: N-able MailAssure server-side request forgery in relay LDAP sync check (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. N-able MailAssure's relay LDAP synchronisation connection check does not restrict its destination, which enables a server-side request forgery flaw. An attacker who can log in with high-level access can reach it remotely over the network to make the server connect to internal hosts and ports, find which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

items.title: CVE-2026-111793: Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder file type restriction bypass in file conversion (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Openwave Messaging's Webtop Media Transcoder does not enforce the file type restrictions set by administrators, so an authenticated user can convert document types that were meant to be blocked. An attacker reaches it over the network with a low-privilege login, by bypassing the Webmail interface and going to the transcoder directly, and attacks using this flaw are happening.

items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal has a JNDI injection flaw that lets an attacker steer the software to an unintended JNDI provider, which could expose or alter information about the server. It can be exploited remotely, without logging in or any user interaction, and it is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Rejetto HTTP File Server (HFS) is affected by a flaw in its search feature that lets an attacker run arbitrary operating system commands on the server hosting it. The attacker can exploit it remotely over the network without logging in, by sending a search request containing a null byte (%00), and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-16666
items.summary: When MCUboot resumes an interrupted image swap it takes the number of bytes to move straight from the flash-resident status trailer. In boot_swap_image() (boot/bootutil/src/loader.c) the fresh-swap branch recomputes copy_size from the image headers and is bounded — swap_run() in boot/bootutil/src/swap_move.c carries an explicit "not enough free space" check (last_idx >= first_trailer_idx) — but that check runs only inside if (boot_status_is_reset(bs)). items.title: CVE-2026-134779
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.6. The affected element is the function Assimp::ColladaLoader::CreateAnimation of the file code/AssetLib/Collada/ColladaLoader.cpp of the component Collada Loader. items.title: CVE-2026-134700
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows scene commands to reference PROTO sub-graph nodes freed by a scene replace command. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that causes gf_node_get_field() and gf_node_unregister() to access freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134688
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the BT/XMT context loader that frees an interaction-type decoder-specific descriptor even when UIConfig re-encoding fails. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a BIFSConfig descriptor, causing gf_odf_delete_descriptor() to reuse and free it again, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134684
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that leaves freed node URL fields in the pending object descriptor link list after SFNode replacement. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that reassigns a single-node field, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing the process and potentially corrupting the heap.

items.title: CVE-2026-134677
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory via stale object descriptor links. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene where xmt_node_end() frees a subtree containing InputSensor MFURL fields, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory and crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134671
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted XMT files. Attackers can persuade a user to process an XMT file whose discarded out-of-scope nodes cause gf_node_unregister() to dereference a freed child, crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134668
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory when xmt_node_end() discards an out-of-scope node without resetting command-buffer state. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that leaves parser->command_buffer and parser->command dangling, causing later parsing to access freed memory and crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134666
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader because xmt_node_end() frees unattached nodes but leaves them on the parser node stack. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose text content makes xmt_text_content() pass the freed node to gf_node_get_tag(), reading freed heap memory and crashing MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134665
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory by supplying a crafted XMT file. When xmt_parse_element() replaces an SFNode field child, the freed node stays cached in parser->peeked_nodes and a later DEF lookup passes it to gf_node_get_name(), crashing MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134663
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that retains a pointer to a PROTO sub-graph freed by gf_sg_proto_del(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file imported with MP4Box, causing xmt_parse_command() to update the freed graph's referencing_commands list and crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134662
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a double free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that leaves a stale GF_Command pointer in a Conditional node's SFCommandBuffer when the buffer element is not properly closed. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file with malformed nesting, causing gf_sg_sfcommand_del() to free the live command, corrupting heap memory and crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-133461
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.10.0, the OAuth authorize endpoint redirects to unvalidated error redirect targets. An attacker can craft a link on the platform's own domain that redirects a signed-in user to an attacker-controlled site, which can present a lookalike consent or sign-in page to harvest credentials. This issue is fixed in version 0.10.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-136190
items.summary: RayLabsHQ gitea-mirror before 3.38.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /api/sso/providers handlers that allows any authenticated user to access other users' SSO providers without ownership checks. Attackers can read every OIDC client secret in clear text and overwrite or delete providers, redirecting authorization and token endpoints to attacker-controlled servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-132264
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.63 through 0.10.0, an external API key or OAuth token that has only the EXECUTE_BLOCK permission can run AutoPilotBlock through the external API and receive a full, unattended AutoPilot turn. This lets the holder use the account owner's stored third-party credentials, library agents, and workspace files, and run AutoPilot's sandboxed shell, which the same key is refused when it requests those directly. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-135798
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in Volans NGFW Next-Generation Firewall r5.1. The affected element is an unknown function of the file include/sqlite3.inc of the component Web Management Interface. Performing a manipulation results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-129317
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.41 through 0.11.1, the OAuth provider endpoints check a calling application's client secret against a scrypt hash synchronously on the REST API event loop. Anyone who knows the client ID of an active confidential OAuth application can stall the REST API for all users by sending a stream of requests with a wrong secret. No account or token is required. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-132257
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From versions 0.6.23 and above, before 0.8.0, AutoGPT Platform ships a hardcoded default Fernet encryption key in backend/.env.default, which encrypts every user's OAuth tokens, API keys, and integration credentials in the User.integrations column. Anyone with read access to the database of a deployment using the default key can decrypt the stored credentials. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-115901
items.summary: Exploitation requires an identity admitted to a configured trusted IdP application, control of claims selected as the OIDC user identifier, acceptance by configured SSO filters, and a victim with an active Cribl session following a crafted authentication link. Script executes in the Cribl origin, disclosing the victim's session token and permitting access with the victim's privileges; administrator access requires an administrator victim.

items.title: CVE-2026-120382

items.title: CVE-2026-134835
items.summary: Langfuse before 4.82.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows organization admins to target internal hosts by setting the GitHub Enterprise SSO baseUrl, which skips outbound-URL validation. Attackers can point baseUrl to loopback, RFC1918, or cloud metadata addresses so user sign-ins trigger server requests carrying stored OAuth client credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-134822
items.summary: Sustainsys.Saml2 before 1.0.4 and 2.x before 2.11.1 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability that allows attackers to tamper with signed parameters by exploiting mis-parsing in CheckSignature() of Saml2RedirectBinding.cs. Attackers can append data after an extra '=' in RelayState of an intercepted or replayed Redirect-binding message, causing applications to trust the tampered value.

items.title: CVE-2026-134805
items.summary: Zipline before 4.8.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated OIDC users to make the server fetch arbitrary URLs via the userinfo picture claim. Attackers who control their picture claim at the identity provider can force fetchToDataURL() to request internal or cloud-metadata URLs and read responses from their stored avatar.

items.title: CVE-2026-134816
items.summary: sigstore-js @sigstore/oci before 0.8.0 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that leaks registry credentials by replaying OAuth2 password-grant request bodies on cross-origin 307 or 308 redirects. items.summary: Vikunja from 1.0.0 before 2.8.0 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows attackers to hijack SSO identities by planting local accounts with unverified victim emails. When emailfallback is enabled, attackers register or edit a local account using the victim's email, causing the victim's first OIDC login to link into the attacker-controlled account and expose their data.

items.title: CVE-2026-134262
items.summary: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows role administrators to inject JavaScript by placing quote-breaking payloads in role names rendered unencoded in the data-message attribute in modules/profile/roles_functions.php. Attackers can execute scripts when a full administrator views an affected profile page, stealing the CSRF token to assign themselves the Administrator role.

items.title: CVE-2026-134312
items.summary: Better Auth 0.4.9 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an OAuth sign-in authentication flaw that treats unverified provider emails as verified, including string "false" email_verified claims, unchecked generic OAuth profile/ID-token subject mismatches, and ignored Zoom provider options. Attackers holding a victim's address unverified at an affected provider can sign in, link to the victim's local account, and obtain its session.

items.title: CVE-2026-136229
items.summary: When a signed OpenPGP/MIME message had no Date header, or one that could not be parsed, Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date. For S/MIME messages with more than one Date header, a later Date header could be used for the comparison. An attacker who had an old signed message could resend it and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-136228
items.summary: Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date for messages that were both signed and encrypted with OpenPGP/MIME. An attacker who had an old signed message could encrypt it to the victim and resend it with a current date, and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-136228
items.summary: Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date for messages that were both signed and encrypted with OpenPGP/MIME. An attacker who had an old signed message could encrypt it to the victim and resend it with a current date, and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-136229
items.summary: When a signed OpenPGP/MIME message had no Date header, or one that could not be parsed, Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date. For S/MIME messages with more than one Date header, a later Date header could be used for the comparison. An attacker who had an old signed message could resend it and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

Looking back, I see three periods in how attackers have spent their attention. Until about 2000, the internet was quiet. A server could stay online for weeks without receiving anything unusual. A port scan was rare enough that some administrators wrote to the abuse contact of the network it came from. If someone attacked you, a person had chosen you. Then the noise began. items.title: Deploy Laravel to your own VPS with zero downtime, for free (with Cipi)
items.summary: Deploying Laravel usually goes one of two ways. You pay every month for a hosted panel that manages your servers, or you spend a weekend with Nginx configs, PHP-FPM pools, Supervisor files, certbot and a deploy script that one day takes the site down mid-release. There's a third way. Cipi is a free, open-source (MIT) tool that you install on the server itself . One command turns a fresh Ubuntu VPS into a platform for many Laravel apps: zero-downtime deploys from Git, queues, the scheduler, HTTPS, backups and security patches. items.summary: Interview with Jeremiah Grossman Once again, we're discussing the state of vulnerability discovery and vulnerability management with Jeremiah Grossman, the CEO and co-founder of Root Evidence. For this interview, I’m calling our topic the “commons dilemma”, which is related to the tragedy of the commons. To quote Wikipedia: the commons dilemma is a specific class of social dilemma in which people’s short-term selfish interests are at odds with long-term group interests and the common good. We discuss the disconnect between vulnerability discovery, defenders, and attackers. Some find vulns for…

items.title: CVE-2020-13925: Apache Kylin remote command execution in REST API (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Apache Kylin has a flaw in one of its REST APIs, where user input is joined into operating system commands and run on the server without proper validation. Remotely, without logging in, an attacker could run arbitrary OS commands on the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-99385: Linux kernel buffer overflow in SMB2_tcon() of SMB client (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A buffer overflow in the SMB client of the Linux kernel lets an oversized network share path write past the end of a heap buffer when connecting to a share. Based on the severity rating, an attacker could reach this remotely without logging in, potentially gaining control of the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-99679: Linux kernel shutdown and stale data in XFS pNFS commits (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's XFS file system can be shut down or exposed to stale data when a client commits a hole in a pNFS LAYOUTCOMMIT, because the nfsd server does not check the committed extents against its layouts. A large hole overruns the block reservation and forces an XFS shutdown, while a small one exposes stale data.

items.title: CVE-2026-99676: Linux kernel race condition in IPv4 and IPv6 socket lookups (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's networking code could reorder socket accesses ahead of reference-count acquisition on weakly ordered processors, because a memory-ordering guarantee was lost in a kernel change. The fix restores acquire and release ordering in the IPv4 and IPv6 socket lookups, TIME_WAIT handling, and related socket paths.

items.title: CVE-2026-99680: Linux kernel file data corruption in XFS pNFS write layouts (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's XFS filesystem code can fail to mark an inode when a pNFS write layout maps blocks past end of file. Those blocks can be freed by background cleanup while still in use under the layout and then given to another file.

items.title: CVE-2026-99356: Linux kernel stale data use in SUNRPC over TLS (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's SUNRPC code mishandles certain TLS control records on TCP sockets, so its RPC stream counts octets it never received. A conforming client that sends a TLS KeyUpdate can trigger this, causing stale data to be used for fragment markers and message bodies.

items.title: CVE-2026-99370: Linux kernel wrong data written in NFSD SETXATTR handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The NFSD server component of the Linux kernel can copy the wrong bytes into the value of an extended attribute set through a SETXATTR request. This happens when the request data is split across buffer segments with a nonzero starting offset or spans into the tail.

items.title: CVE-2026-99366: Linux kernel remote denial of service in NFS server (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's NFS server (nfsd) can crash with a NULL pointer dereference, which panics the system. The crash happens when two replays of cached replies run on the same session slot at once, because a replay wrongly modifies that slot.

items.title: CVE-2026-99513: Linux kernel use-after-free in lockd blocked lock retries (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's lockd component contains a use-after-free bug in how it retries blocked lock requests. Unmounting the nfsd filesystem while a lock request is still blocked can free memory that the kernel then reads.

items.title: CVE-2026-99544: Linux kernel out-of-bounds write in Hyper-V VMBus ring buffer (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's Hyper-V VMBus driver trusts ring buffer position values kept in memory shared with the host, so an untrusted host of a confidential VM can set them out of range and make the guest write data far outside the ring buffer. The flaw is reached locally without logging in or any user action.

items.title: CVE-2026-99590: Linux kernel out-of-bounds write in ceph inline data handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's Ceph client can be made to write past the end of a memory buffer when a malicious or faulty metadata server sends back more inline data than the buffer can hold. An attacker can reach this remotely without logging in, and it could let them corrupt memory and potentially take over or crash the system.

items.title: CVE-2026-99634: Linux kernel use-after-free in MPTCP subflow setup (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A flaw in the Linux kernel's Multipath TCP code mishandles Fast Open on additional subflow connections, so a freed connection object can be exposed when the system accepts a connection. An attacker can reach it remotely without logging in, which could let them take control of or crash the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-121810: F5 NGINX Plus remote denial of service in HTTP/3 module (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source are affected when they use HTTP/3. A remote attacker without logging in can trigger a use-after-free in the worker process, causing a restart and denial of service, and under certain conditions may be able to run code, though exploitation depends on factors outside the attacker's control.

items.title: CVE-2026-123007: F5 NGINX Plus memory corruption in HTTP/2 module via integer underflow (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. F5's NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source are affected when they use HTTP/2. A remote attacker who can reach the server without logging in can crash an NGINX worker process or corrupt its memory, and may be able to execute code, but only if Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) is disabled or the attacker can bypass it.

items.title: CVE-2026-123633: F5 NGINX Open Source memory corruption in HTTP/2 module (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. NGINX Open Source and NGINX Plus are affected when configured to use HTTP/2 for client connections and proxy those requests to a backend. Remote attackers can reach the flaw over the network without logging in, using a specially crafted request that can crash the worker process or, on systems with ASLR disabled or bypassed, allow code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-33526: Squid denial of service in ICP request handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Squid, a caching proxy for the Web, has a use-after-free flaw in how it handles ICP traffic. A remote attacker can use it to cause a reliable, repeatable denial of service without logging in, but only on deployments that explicitly enable ICP support by setting a non-zero `icp_port`. Blocking ICP queries with `icp_access` rules does not prevent the attack.

items.title: CVE-2020-11652: SaltStack Salt path traversal in master server file handling (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. SaltStack Salt's salt-master process has a flaw in how it cleans up file paths, which lets an attacker who has a low-privilege login read arbitrary directories on the salt master. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network with no user interaction, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2025-68461: Roundcube Webmail cross-site scripting via SVG animate tag (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Roundcube Webmail has a cross-site scripting flaw that lets an attacker run their own script in a victim's browser within the Roundcube webmail page, by supplying an SVG document with an animate tag that the HTML sanitizer fails to block. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, and attacks using it are happening.

items.title: CVE-2024-20353: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software denial of service in management and VPN web servers (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense Software have a flaw in their management and VPN web servers that lets an attacker crash a device and cause a denial of service, remotely and without logging in, by sending a crafted HTTP request that makes it reload unexpectedly. It needs a non-default setup with an SSL listen socket enabled, and attacks using ...

items.title: CVE-2026-32201: Microsoft SharePoint Enterprise Server 2016 spoofing flaw in input validation (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Microsoft SharePoint Server (including the 2016 Enterprise, 2019 and Subscription Edition releases) has an input validation flaw that lets an attacker carry out spoofing, such as presenting forged content or data as genuine. The attacker can reach it remotely over a network, without logging in or any user interaction, and attacks using it are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-16665
items.summary: Summary MCUboot enforces several security-critical invariants on the boot, image-swap, and validation paths using assert(). In a standard release/production build (NDEBUG defined) assert() expands to a no-op, so an invariant the code intends to halt on instead falls through, and execution continues with the bad or inconsistent state. Where the guarded condition is attacker-influenceable through the flash-write boundary (serial-recovery / DFU), this is a security check that is simply absent in release builds. This is one root cause (assert-as-security-guard, no-op under NDEBUG) with one fix app…

items.title: CVE-2026-61513
items.summary: VeraCrypt through 1.26.31 on Linux contains an improper path restriction vulnerability in the elevated CoreService, which passes the path and owner UID from a SetFileOwnerRequest directly to chown() in CoreUnix::SetFileOwner without target validation on Linux. An attacker with an active elevated CoreService session and same-UID access who reopens the request pipe through /proc//fd/ can take ownership of arbitrary system files such as /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow, achieving full root compromise.

items.title: CVE-2026-136421
items.summary: rocket.chat Server-Side Request Forgery Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of rocket.chat. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the web service, which listens on TCP port 3000 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a URI prior to accessing resources. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-29853.

items.title: CVE-2026-61512
items.summary: VeraCrypt before 1.26.30 on Linux contains a command injection vulnerability in CoreUnix::CheckFilesystem that allows a local attacker with same-UID access and an active elevated CoreService session to execute arbitrary commands by injecting an unsanitized VirtualDevice value into a shell command string. Attackers can reopen the request pipe through /proc//fd/ and supply a crafted VirtualDevice value such as /dev/null; to achieve arbitrary command execution as root.

items.title: CVE-2026-132260
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Any user with a positive credit balance can keep sandboxes running for up to 24 hours on a Pro plan for a flat 1 credit, and each run adds another sandbox. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-132256

There is no confidentiality or integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 0.10.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-136328
items.summary: A flaw was found in the file-psd plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted PSD (Photoshop Document) image file in LAB color mode, the plugin does not properly validate that a fourth channel is present when the transparency flag is set. This mismatch causes the merged-image path to allocate buffers for three components while performing color conversion with four-component formats, resulting in a heap-based buffer overflow. This issue can result in an application crash, leading to a denial of service, or potentially allow for arbitrary code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-136199
items.summary: libical before 4.0.7 contains a denial of service vulnerability because icalparser_clean() does not reset the parser nesting level when reusing an icalparser. Attackers can submit a single malformed calendar with unclosed or mismatched BEGIN/END lines, causing later calendars to be silently dropped and memory to grow unbounded.

items.title: CVE-2026-136198
items.summary: Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an invalid mesh reference vulnerability in glTF2Exporter::ExportMeshes that causes out-of-bounds access when meshes without faces are skipped during export. Attackers can supply a PLY point cloud or degenerate glTF 2.0 TRIANGLE_STRIP model exported to gltf2 or glb2 to crash the application or trigger out-of-bounds memory reads and writes.

items.title: CVE-2026-136197
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the glTF 1.0 importer that allows attackers to read adjacent heap memory by supplying an unchecked KHR_binary_glTF image bufferView. Attackers can craft a glTF or GLB file whose bufferView byteOffset or byteLength exceeds its buffer, disclosing heap memory through embedded texture data or crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-136196
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_mpeg4 that allows remote attackers to trigger excessive looping by advertising an undersized AU-headers-length. Attackers can send a crafted 22-byte AAC-hbr RTP packet from an RTP sender or malicious RTSP server to run about 2^28 iterations, pinning a CPU core and stalling clients.

items.title: CVE-2026-136195
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_mpeg4 that allows remote attackers to crash clients by sending MP4V-ES RTP payloads shorter than 4 bytes. A remote RTP sender or malicious RTSP server can send a short packet after a marker-bit packet, causing an unsigned wraparound in the VOP start-code search loop that reads past the buffer and causes denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-136194
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_amr that allows remote RTP senders or malicious RTSP servers to read beyond packet buffers by sending crafted AMR/AMR-WB payloads. Attackers can send short packets whose TOC entries all set the F bit, causing out-of-bounds frame data to be copied into decoder output, disclosing memory or crashing the client.

items.title: CVE-2026-136193
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the STAP-A handling of gf_rtp_parse_h264 in rtp_depacketizer.c due to unchecked aggregation unit sizes. A malicious RTP sender or RTSP server can send STAP-A packets with oversized NAL unit lengths to disclose adjacent heap memory or crash the client.

items.title: CVE-2026-136192
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SDP_ParseAttribute that allows attackers to cause unbounded memory growth via a NUL byte in an a=fmtp line. Attackers can supply a crafted .sdp file or malicious RTSP DESCRIBE response to hang gf_sdp_info_parse and exhaust memory, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-136191
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in gf_rtsp_do_deinterleave that allows malicious RTSP servers to hang clients by sending non-RTSP, non-interleaved data. Attackers can answer a client request with a few bytes not starting with '$', 'RTSP', or 'HTTP', causing the RTSP client thread to spin forever and consume a full CPU core.

items.title: CVE-2026-136189
items.summary: Schmitech ORBIT before 2.17.15 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the permission_or_api_key dependency that allows any valid API key to access /admin management routes. Attackers holding a chat inference API key can read other keys in plaintext, rewrite config.yaml, and manage adapters and prompts to take over server administration.

items.title: CVE-2026-136188
items.summary: Spug before 4.1.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated non-administrator users to read per-host SSH private keys through the GET /api/host/ endpoint. Users granted a host can read the cleartext pkey field returned by Host.to_view and log in directly over SSH, bypassing Spug's permissions and audit trail even after revocation.

items.title: CVE-2026-136187
items.summary: Spug 4.0.0 before 4.1.1 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to execute commands by supplying a crafted git URL to the /api/credential/check/ endpoint. Attackers can inject shell metacharacters into the data field passed to git ls-remote with shell=True, executing commands as the Spug service account, which is root in Docker deployments.

items.title: CVE-2026-136183
items.summary: Mercur @mercurjs/core before 2.3.2 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated vendors to access other sellers by substituting the :id path parameter. Attackers can read payment and tax details, overwrite profiles and addresses, and invite, remove, or re-role team members to take over another vendor's store.

items.title: CVE-2026-136180
items.summary: Movary before 0.78.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated non-admin users to make the server request internal hosts by submitting crafted Jellyfin or Plex server URLs. Attackers can target internal services directly since URL validation is disabled by default, or bypass it via DNS rebinding, redirects, or AAAA records to probe internal network state.

In versions 0.6.1 through 0.10.0, credentials are sent to a third party when a redirect's Location header hides the new host behind a backslash. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-136231

items.title: CVE-2026-136230

This affected both setting up a new address book and syncing existing ones, where a saved password could be sent without any user interaction. A malicious or compromised proxy could use this to obtain the address book credentials, even for address books served over HTTPS. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

This happens whether or not validation is…

items.summary: Uncontrolled Recursion vulnerability in the external term format decoder in Erlang OTP erts allows an attacker who controls the input to binary_to_term/1,2 to abort the Erlang VM via a fun term with funs nested in its integer fields. dec_term in erts/emulator/beam/external.c decodes terms iteratively, except for the OldIndex and OldUniq fields of NEW_FUN_EXT and the Arity field of EXPORT_EXT. For these fields it calls itself, and it checks that the result is a small integer only after the call returns. An input that places another fun in such a field, nested to sufficient depth, recurses once…

items.title: CVE-2026-116295
items.summary: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences in HTTP Headers ('HTTP Request/Response Splitting') vulnerability in Erlang OTP inets (httpc module) allows HTTP Request Splitting. httpc writes request header names and values to the wire without neutralizing CR, LF or NUL characters. On the default path http_request:mk_key_value_str/2, and with the headers_as_is option httpc_request:http_headers/2, build each header line by plain concatenation of the name, ": ", the value and CRLF. A CR/LF in a name or value ends the header line early. An attacker who controls data that an application puts into a hea…

items.title: CVE-2026-116293
items.summary: Out-of-bounds Write vulnerability in the external term format decoder in Erlang OTP erts allows an attacker who controls the input to binary_to_term/1,2 to abort the Erlang VM via a NEWER_REFERENCE_EXT term with a zero-length ID. decoded_size in erts/emulator/beam/external.c accepts a reference whose 16-bit Len field is zero, but dec_term always reads one ID word. dec_term then runs 4 bytes ahead of the position that decoded_size validated. It decodes the bytes that follow as terms that were never sized, and writes past the reserved process heap. The abort takes down every process on the node.…

Its check rejects functions, PIDs, ports and references, but it accepts maps, and therefore structs of any module. Flop passes the decoded values to Ecto as query parameters. items.title: CVE-2026-136155
items.summary: In Valkey 9.1.0 and 9.1.1, the Lua script debugger builds its command table once and caches it with a pointer to the Lua interpreter state that was current at the time. items.title: CVE-2026-86156
items.summary: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') can allow SPARQL Update to access data from local server. This issue affects Apache Jena Fuseki through 6.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.

SendEmailBlock and SQLQueryBlock logged in with the running user's saved SMTP or database credential to whatever server the graph's author put in the node's inputs, with no check that the login belonged to that server. Anyone who publishes a marketplace listing or shares an agent file can capture the saved login of each user who adds it to their library and ru…

items.summary: XML Injection vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_s3 allows an attacker who controls tag keys or values to inject forged tag entries into S3 object and bucket tagging requests.
